items.title: Robert Lewis Interview 1959-11-10
items.q: he just didn't think he was the musician that Sidney Vichay was.

ctx.x: Yeah. Did he make any remarks, especially if you remember, about Dodds? Why didn't he like him so well? Maybe he couldn't read what he thought so well, or what?
Well, he just didn't think he was the musician that Sidney Vichay was. Yeah.
Well, Dodds would have said that too.
